rapport_notes: Warm, patient, handled a complex piano/storage move with genuine care.

evidence_quotes.agenda: "do you have any special instructions, concerns or stressors about moving in general or about this move that you want us to take note of as of this time?"
evidence_quotes.two_layers_deep: Customer raised concern about the piano being wrapped for storage; rep gave a direct, specific answer (blanket pads, rentable) but did not ask a further follow-up question to see if anything else was on her mind.
evidence_quotes.save_your_ass: "If you go over the minimum, we only charge in every fifteen minutes. So we don't charge like for the full hour right away."

top_strength: Opened with full quid-pro-quo framing (time-boxed ask + promise of pricing) — one of the cleanest openers in the batch.
coaching_note: Ask the agenda/concerns question earlier, before the full logistics runthrough, so it can actually shape the rest of the call.
